_comment: Ingest sources for scripts/ingest/run_ingest.py (--config mode) and the seed for public.schedule_sources. `adapter` picks the reader (fiba_livestats | genius_html | bbl_2bbl | euroleague_api | eurobasket_html | bcb_pipeline). Non-FIBA leagues change the adapter, never the pipeline. league_id / competition_id are the Supabase uuids for that league (fill from the admin console); leave null to run discovery-only dry runs.
